title: OCW_Obscure's_CollegeofWinterhold - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 6 NPCs from OCW_Obscure's_CollegeofWinterhold.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by OCW_Obscure's_CollegeofWinterhold (OCW_Obscure's_CollegeofWinterhold.esp).

Install this if OCW_Obscure's_CollegeofWinterhold.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
